{{Quote|Try the Howler. It's a bar. It's where you'll find locals with an itch to get offworld but not enough money to do so.|Revos Spaceport official|<ref name="ws">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''The Howler''' was a bar in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Revos]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]]. It was a dim dining establishment with dirty floors and tables. It had [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] on all the walls that showed nothing but old images of Storinal's landscapes and cities. It was one of the few places on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled world where non-humans were permitted.<ref name="ws" />

During [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to Storinal, they all rendezvoused at the Howler to check on each strike group's progress.<ref name="ws" />
